Learn about Authenticate®
Learn About Our Advanced Identity Verification, Fraud Prevention Features, Global Data Coverage, and Compliance Standards.
What Is Authenticate®?
Authenticate® is a comprehensive identity verification solution that safeguards businesses from fraud and enhances user trust. Our platform utilizes advanced technology to verify identities, screen for criminal records, and ensure safety & security along with regulatory requirements. With Authenticate®’s easy APIs and NO CODE Solutions, businesses can streamline their verification process and mitigate risks effectively.
Discover How Authenticate Can Empower You
Authenticate® provides robust solutions to enhance trust, streamline processes, and mitigate business risks worldwide. From identity verification to compliance assurance, fraud prevention, and global reach, Authenticate® is your trusted partner in securing and verifying identities confidently.
Identity Verification: Authenticate® offers robust identity verification solutions, utilizing advanced technology to authenticate individuals and businesses accurately.
Background Checks: Streamline the background check process with Authenticate®'s comprehensive screening capabilities, including criminal record checks, education & employment verification, professional license verification, identity verification, and more.
Compliance Assurance: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements through Authenticate's adherence to industry standards and best practices.
Fraud Prevention: Protect your business from fraudulent activities and unauthorized access with Authenticate®'s proactive fraud prevention measures.
Global Reach: With access to a vast database of government IDs from over 200 countries and 38 languages, Authenticate® offers global verification solutions for businesses operating international individuals and companies accurately
What Is Medallion?
Medallion™ is a cutting-edge web-based authentication platform businesses seamless identity verification and background checks. With real-time feedback, automated ID recognition & liveness assessment, and manual review options, Medallion™ ensures swift and accurate verification processes. Plus, with a vast database of over 6,500 government IDs from 200 countries, including active/passive liveness detection, it's a trusted solution for global verification needs.
What Is ReAuthenticate ™?
At its core, ReAuthenticate™, with its world-class Identity Verification APIs, faster eKYCs & other tools, is a security mechanism designed to repeatedly verify your identity during a single session or after a certain period with just a selfie. ReAuthenticate™ helps you to increase efficiency by verifying returning users with a selfie and comparing it to previous records in our databases. Unlocking a faster, more secure verification process.
What countries are supported?
Authenticate® has an extensive coverage of over 200 countries and 38 languages, supporting a global audience. Our platform offers verification services for government-issued IDs from diverse countries, ensuring comprehensive coverage and compliance with international verification standards.
